title: grover-tax fixture v0.2
description: Schema for fixtures/v0.2.json — the gate-execution apples-to-apples fixture (RFC-0015). y_hex is the 32-byte circuit output state; x_hex retains the v0.1 128-char layout, of which the prover only consumes the first 32 bytes (RFC-0015 §3.5).

version.description: Fixture-format version. Frozen at 'v0.2' for the entire v0.2.x series (F-INV-7).

generator_commit.description: Repo SHA at the time gen_fixtures.py produced this file. Excluded from --check normalisation.

workload_pin_commit.description: Upstream zkp_ecc SHA recorded in WORKLOAD.md frontmatter at generation time.

n_samples.description: Number of test cases. Must equal len(test_cases) (F-INV-1).

bit_stripe_width.description: Reversible-circuit bit-stripe width W from WORKLOAD.md.

circuit_serialisation_format_version.description: Canonical serialisation format version (F-INV-6). v0.2 freezes this at 1 (GTV1).

circuit_byte_serialisation_hex.description: Canonical GTV1 byte serialisation of gate-list C, lowercase hex, even length (F-INV-8).

circuit_commitment_blake2s_hex.description: blake2s(bytes.fromhex(circuit_byte_serialisation_hex)) — 32-byte digest, no personalisation. Verified by F-INV-3.

test_cases.description: Ordered list of (x, y) test cases; iteration order is binding (F-INV-9). v0.2 prover consumes x_hex[:64] and y_hex[:64].

x_hex.description: Test-case input. 128 lowercase-hex chars (64 bytes) preserved from v0.1 schema for backward compatibility; v0.2 prover consumes only the first 32 bytes (RFC-0015 §3.5).

y_hex.description: Circuit output state. 64 lowercase-hex chars (32 bytes = 256-bit state, RFC-0015 §3.5).
